scope: Static source inventory only. Tests listed here are present, not necessarily passing. Installation, credentials, runtime service loading and real call/payment acceptance require separate evidence.

features.name: Account Range
features.detail: Tenant-scoped customer account-number ranges with stable allocation, range exhaustion checks and audit records. Separate from SIP usernames and native Olamide SIP account IDs.

features.name: Alarms
features.detail: Server monitoring exists; trunk and call-event alarms are incomplete.

features.name: Automated Report
features.detail: Scheduled usage and invoice summaries persist generated results and support authenticated retrieval. Mail retries are durable and tenant scoped. Authorized mail credentials and inbox acceptance testing are required.

features.name: Access Control
features.detail: Role and navigation permissions exist; portal/API IP rules need implementation.

features.name: Advanced SIP Routing
features.detail: Route preview and fraud rules exist; cause-based extension failover is not installed.

features.name: Automated CDRs
features.detail: Scheduled bounded raw CDR CSV.gz archives and summary reports are implemented. Archives retain originals, enforce tenant isolation and include SHA-256 checksums. External cold storage and continuous full-history archival remain pending.

features.name: ACL Management
features.detail: Network controls exist; a unified SIP ACL module is incomplete.

features.name: Country Reports
features.detail: Settled paid-call usage and USD revenue are grouped by configured longest country or numbering-region prefixes. Unmapped destinations remain Unclassified.

features.name: Demand-Based Routing
features.detail: UTC weekday calling-window policies are enforced in paid-call authorization. Carrier selection by time window remains pending.

features.name: DID Call Transfer
features.detail: Disposition-based DID failover is not installed.

features.name: Fax over IP
features.detail: Requires a fax engine, storage and provider/media integration.

features.name: Fraud Detection
features.detail: Destination blocks and prepaid concurrency checks exist; anomaly detection is incomplete.

features.name: International Credit Management
features.detail: Per-user monthly international USD budgets include outstanding reservations and current-month settled charges under the tenant billing lock. Home-prefix calls use the normal wallet budget. Live call acceptance is unverified.

features.name: Local Number
features.detail: DID inventory exists; shared-DID service routing is incomplete.

features.name: Logs
features.detail: Operations controls exist; redacted live service-log streaming is incomplete.

features.name: Languages
features.detail: Language/locale settings exist; full interface translation coverage is incomplete.

features.name: Mailchimp
features.detail: Requires an integration implementation and authorized Mailchimp credentials.

features.name: Multi-Tenant IP PBX
features.detail: Tenant-scoped PBX records exist; live IVR, queues and voicemail need a media/PBX engine.

features.name: Number Portability Service
features.detail: Port-request records exist; global portability lookup requires a data provider.

features.name: Ported Number—South Africa
features.detail: Requires a South African portability dataset/API and implementation.

features.name: Personalized Rates
features.detail: Account-specific longest-prefix USD rates and billing intervals are applied to prepaid reservations and settlement. Active carrier coverage remains required. Live call acceptance is unverified.

features.name: Payfast
features.detail: Requires a signed webhook/payment integration and merchant credentials.

features.name: Rate Simulator
features.detail: A tariff route preview exists; it does not prove live switch rating.

features.name: Stripe Payment Gateway
features.detail: Stripe management exists; every advertised payment flow is not implemented.

features.name: Support Ticket
features.detail: Existing tenant-scoped tickets, replies and status actions are available.

features.name: Schedule Reports
features.detail: Durable per-administrator report schedules, row-locked job claims, persisted snapshots, bounded retries, provider idempotency and mail-attempt history are implemented. Authorized mail credentials and inbox acceptance testing are required.

features.name: Shadow Billing
features.detail: An independent, idempotent comparison ledger snapshots configured shadow rates at reservation and records actual versus shadow charges at settlement without changing wallets. Live event acceptance is unverified.

features.name: Switch Monitoring
features.detail: Kamailio readiness exists. Native FreeSWITCH monitoring is outside the selected architecture.

features.name: Two-Factor Authentication
features.detail: Passkeys and OTP flows exist; exact vendor MFA parity is not established.

features.name: WHMCS integration
features.detail: Requires a WHMCS connector and authorized API account.

features.name: Zoho CRM integration
features.detail: Requires CRM connector implementation and OAuth authorization.

features.name: Salesforce integration
features.detail: Requires CRM connector implementation and OAuth authorization.

features.name: STIR/SHAKEN
features.detail: Requires approved signing credentials, certificate lifecycle and SIP integration.

features.name: Mobile Dialer
features.detail: App download controls exist; native background-calling acceptance remains separate.

features.name: PC Dialer
features.detail: Web calling exists; full desktop dialer parity is not established.

features.name: Prepaid & postpaid charging
features.detail: Kamailio prepaid deployment exists. Postpaid, prorating, bundles and surcharge rules remain incomplete.

features.name: DID lifecycle
features.detail: Inventory/provider controls exist; full purchase/release/recurring lifecycle depends on integrations.

features.name: Call center & autodialer
features.detail: PBX/call-center controls exist; live AMD, IVR, conferencing and interception need compatible engines.

features.name: SMS delivery & billing
features.detail: SMS endpoints exist; provider acceptance and full SMS rating remain incomplete.

features.name: Resellers & commissions
features.detail: Authorized tenant reseller stores, catalogs, orders and delegated payment gateway management are implemented. Hierarchical carrier rating, commissions and provider portals remain incomplete.

features.name: Archive, purge & cron
features.detail: Tenant-scoped manual and scheduled compressed CDR archives, authenticated downloads and archive-copy removal are implemented. Automatic original-record retention/deletion and external cold storage are not implemented.

features.name: n8n integration
features.detail: Requires authenticated workflow connectors and an n8n instance.
